setting.name: Caribdus
setting.era: Sailing age — flintlocks, powder, and rope; no heavy industry
setting.tone: Swashbuckling dread; salt spray, superstition, and sudden violence
setting.summary: Caribdus is a chain of storm-battered isles half-swallowed by the Deluge. Every cove hides a flag, every reef hides teeth.

world_rules.magic: Common — sea-witch hedge magic, cursed relics from the Deluge, and tide-bound rituals. Arcane academies are absent; power smells of brine and blood.
world_rules.technology: Sailing age — flintlock pistols, cutlasses, schooners, and diving bells. No steam, no mass production; shipyards hand-fit every hull.
world_rules.travel: Open sea between isles; reef pilots required in the archipelago; Ghost Shoals warp compasses.

politics.summary: Colonial armadas claim harbors with cannon and charter; pirate republics vote captains by steel and spoils; sea-witch covens trade storms for souls along the Ghost Shoals.

regions.name: Open Sea
regions.description: Trackless swells between island chains. Squalls rise without warning; hulls groan on long swells.
regions.travel_notes: Navigation checks each day; off-course drift toward Ghost Shoals on failed rolls.

regions.name: Central Archipelago
regions.description: The heart of Caribdus — crowded anchorages, reef mazes, and the three great ports.
regions.travel_notes: Inter-island hops take hours by sloop; reef pilots charge 5 gp per passage.

regions.name: Ghost Shoals
regions.description: Mist-wrapped shallows where compasses spin and drowned bells toll at dusk.
regions.travel_notes: Visibility rarely exceeds 100 ft.; sea-witch pacts rumored to calm the fog.

regions.name: Deep Trench
regions.description: A black scar in the ocean floor. Bioluminescent hunters and Deluge ruins lurk below the thermocline.
regions.travel_notes: Surface ships avoid the trench; diving bells and enchanted lungs are mandatory.

cities.name: Puerto Sombrío
cities.description: Grim port of fifteen thousand souls where Crown tariffs meet pirate gold. Smoke and tar hang over every dawn.
cities.government: Colonial governor with a bribed council

districts.name: Muelle Viejo
districts.description: Rotting piers and tariff shacks; first sight of Caribdus for many crews.

districts.name: Barrio de las Velas
districts.description: Sail-loft alleys, chandlers, and boarding houses.

districts.name: Muralla Colonial
districts.description: Stone walls, customs house, and the governor's shadow.

cities.name: Perla Azul
cities.description: Lagoon city built on coral pilings. Pearl trade and tide worship keep the peace — barely.
cities.government: Pearl Council of master divers and temple elders

districts.name: Mercado de Perlas
districts.description: Open-air auction pits and diver guild halls.

districts.name: Malecón Dorado
districts.description: Wealthy villas on the lagoon rim.

districts.name: Barrio Pescador
districts.description: Net menders, shrines, and cheap ceviche stalls.

cities.name: Fuerte Almirez
cities.description: Stone citadel and naval anchor of the Crown Armada. Discipline, cannon, and colonial ambition.

districts.name: Cuartel Naval
districts.description: Barracks, powder store, and naval court.

locations.name: Taberna del Ancla Podrida
locations.description: Three-story flophouse favored by bosuns and deserters. Rooms 4 sp; grog 2 cp; stew questionable.
locations.read_aloud: A barnacle-crusted anchor hangs above the door. Inside, dice clatter and a concertina wheezes through pipe smoke.
locations.dm_notes: Tabernero Paco hears every dock rumor. Hidden hatch in the cellar leads toward smuggler tunnels.

locations.name: Astillero Negro
locations.description: Black-tarred slips where hulls are patched between raids. Contramaestre Toro runs the night shift.
locations.read_aloud: Hammer on copper rivets rings across oily water. Cranes swing masts like matchsticks.
locations.dm_notes: Stolen naval timber stored under tarpaulin 7. Athletics DC 14 to slip aboard a refitting sloop.

locations.name: Mercado de Especias
locations.description: Canvas stalls selling pepper, rum, compass needles, and questionable charms.
locations.read_aloud: Spice heat and tar compete in the air. Hawkers bark prices in three languages.

locations.name: Aduana Colonial
locations.description: Customs house where Crown clerks stamp manifests and squeeze bribes.
locations.read_aloud: Wax seals and iron grilles. A clerk's quill scratches like a rat in the wall.
locations.dm_notes: Governor's envoy visits on high tide. Hidden ledger of smuggler payoffs in the vault.

locations.name: Fortín Colonial
locations.description: Cannon battery guarding the harbor mouth. Powder magazine below the parapet.
locations.read_aloud: Salt-crusted cannon stare seaward. Red-coated marines drill in the yard.

locations.name: Taberna de la Perla
locations.description: Diver's tavern with a pearl-inlaid bar. Fresh catch served at dawn.
locations.read_aloud: Mother-of-pearl gleams beneath tankards. Diver tattoos flash in lamplight.

locations.name: Casa de Cambio del Arrecife
locations.description: Money-changer and fence for unmarked pearls. Heavy shutters, heavier guards.
locations.read_aloud: Scales ping. A grille slides open just wide enough for hands and coin.

locations.name: Templo de las Mareas
locations.description: Open-air shrine where tide priests read omens in shell patterns.
locations.read_aloud: Conch horns echo at dusk. Incense of seaweed and myrrh drifts over the lagoon.
locations.dm_notes: Sacerdotisa Coral can bless water-breathing for a tithe.

locations.name: Faro del Malecón
locations.description: White lighthouse guiding lagoon traffic. Cartographer's workshop in the base.
locations.read_aloud: A beam sweeps over coral breakers. Charts rustle in a salt-stained room below.

locations.name: Palacio del Gobernador
locations.description: Marble-faced palace where colonial edicts become law.
locations.read_aloud: Guards in blue coats flank a gate of black iron. Fanfare is optional; taxes are not.

locations.name: Cuartel del Gobernador
locations.description: Naval barracks housing two hundred marines. Armory issues weapons by writ only.
locations.read_aloud: Boot heels crack on stone. The smell of gun oil is stronger than the sea.

locations.name: Astillero de la Corona
locations.description: Crown shipyard building frigates and powder hulks.
locations.read_aloud: Sawdust snows on the quay. A frigate skeleton waits for its copper sheathing.

locations.name: Cantina del Mosquito
locations.description: Off-duty naval tavern. Darts, dice, and discreet duels in the alley.
locations.read_aloud: A mosquito is nailed above the door — wings spread, iron pin through the thorax.

locations.name: Arrecife de Coral Sangriento
locations.description: Crimson coral maze that tears hulls. Sharks patrol the outer rim.
locations.read_aloud: Breakers hiss over coral teeth. The lagoon inside is eerily calm.

locations.name: Cala de los Contrabandistas
locations.description: Hidden cove with camouflaged nets and a pulley hoist into the cliffs.
locations.read_aloud: Tarps mimic rock from the sea. A whistle answers your approach — friend or foe?
locations.dm_notes: Garfio Reyes uses this cove. Smuggler lookouts Perception +4.

locations.name: Choza de la Bruja del Mar
locations.description: Stilt hut on a dead mangrove. Shell wind chimes and cauldron smoke.
locations.read_aloud: A hut squats on stilts above black water. Chimes clack though there is no wind.
locations.dm_notes: Marisela la Bruma trades storms for favors. Coven audience by invitation only.

locations.name: Naufragio Espectral
locations.description: Ghostly galleon fused with the reef. Bells toll at midnight.
locations.read_aloud: Mist parts around a half-sunk hull. Rigging moves with no crew aboard.

locations.name: Faro de la Tormenta
locations.description: Storm-lashed lighthouse on a bare rock. Keeper hasn't been paid in years.
locations.read_aloud: Lightning fractures the sky. The beacon still turns — who fuels it?

locations.name: Templo Sumergido del Abismo
locations.description: Deluge-era temple half buried in the trench wall. Air pockets hold stale breath.
locations.read_aloud: Stone angels stare through green dark. Your lamp throws shadows that move wrong.

locations.name: Fosa Abisal de las Luces
locations.description: Bioluminescent vent field. Pressure and predators end careless dives.
locations.read_aloud: Cold light blooms in the black. Something vast shifts below your keel.

npcs.name: Capitán Valeria Storm
npcs.appearance: Lean woman, storm-gray coat, silver earring shaped like a lightning bolt.
npcs.motivations: Build a fleet that answers to no flag but her own.
npcs.secrets: Owes Marisela a blood debt from a saved crew.
npcs.voice: Laughs mid-sentence; calls everyone 'mate' until they earn a name.
sample_dialogue: I don't sail for kings or coffers — I sail because the sea asked nicely.
Puerto Sombrío's customs man takes bribes in pearls. I take his pride for free.

npcs.name: Marisela la Bruma
npcs.appearance: Salt-white hair; kelp bracelets; eyes like tide pools.
npcs.personality: Patient, ominous, never wastes a word.
npcs.motivations: Bind the trench's waking leviathan back to sleep.
npcs.secrets: Sold calm weather to the Crown once; regrets it.
npcs.voice: Speaks as if every sentence is a prophecy.
sample_dialogue: The sea remembers every oath you break. I merely read the minutes.
Bring salt, blood, and silence. Questions come after.

actions.name: Hex
actions.description: Target −1 all rolls until end of next turn (1/turn)

npcs.name: Gobernador Mateo Almirez
npcs.appearance: Iron-gray uniform, gout limp, signet ring of the Crown.
npcs.personality: Polished cruelty; believes order is mercy.
npcs.motivations: Hang enough pirates to make an example; fill the treasury.
npcs.secrets: Secretly trades prisoners to the coven for storm warnings.
npcs.voice: Soft Spanish cadence; threats wrapped in etiquette.

npcs.name: Garfio Reyes
npcs.appearance: Hook-hand prosthetic (iron, not silver); shark-tooth necklace.
npcs.personality: Grins through danger; loyal to coin.
npcs.secrets: Informant for Valeria Storm when Crown tariffs rise.
npcs.voice: Whispers like a knife sliding from a sheath.

npcs.name: Contramaestre Toro
npcs.appearance: Massive shoulders, tar-stained beard, voice like a capstan.
npcs.motivations: Finish the Blackfin sloop before hurricane season.

npcs.name: Sacerdotisa Coral
npcs.appearance: Coral rosary; bare feet; algae-green shawl.
npcs.personality: Gentle in public; steel when rites are mocked.
npcs.motivations: Keep Perla Azul neutral in the Crown–Corsair war.

npcs.name: Almirante Ribera
npcs.appearance: Braid-heavy uniform; powder burns on left cheek.
npcs.personality: By-the-book; despises pirates and witchcraft equally.
npcs.motivations: Sink Valeria Storm's squadron before the next moon.

npcs.name: Cuervo Salazar
npcs.motivations: Claim Puerto Sombrío's docks for the Council.

npcs.name: Paco el Tabernero
npcs.personality: Fatherly until you break house rules.
npcs.motivations: Keep the Ancla Podrida neutral ground.
sample_dialogue: No blades drawn inside — that's what the alley's for.

npcs.name: Tomás Mir
npcs.appearance: Ink-stained fingers; brass dividers on a chain.
npcs.motivations: Chart the trench without Crown censorship.

npcs.name: Isla Cortavientos
npcs.appearance: Teen sailor; shaved head; knife in boot.
npcs.personality: Quick, curious, fearless to a fault.
npcs.motivations: Earn a berth on Valeria's crew.

npcs.name: Envoy Lucía Mendoza
npcs.appearance: Crown livery; spectacles; ledger always open.
npcs.motivations: Maximize bribes while appearing loyal to Almirez.
npcs.secrets: Keeps a list of smugglers for blackmail.

creatures.name: Reef Shark
creatures.lore: Caribdus sailors call them red fins.

creatures.name: Giant Octopus
creatures.encounter_notes: One per sunken wreck or night dive.

creatures.name: Drowned Sailor
creatures.encounter_notes: 2d6 rising from spectral wreck at dusk.

creatures.name: Bruma Marina
creatures.encounter_notes: Solitary in shoals; with 1d4 drowned sailors.

creatures.name: Pirate Crew
creatures.encounter_notes: Crew of 6-12 with one Wild Card captain.
creatures.lore: Mix of Corsair Council and freelancers.

creatures.name: Giant Crab
creatures.encounter_notes: 1-2 on tidal flats or pearl beds.

creatures.name: Jellyfish Swarm
creatures.lore: Called crown lace by Almirez marines.

creatures.name: Crown Marine
creatures.encounter_notes: Squad of 4-8 with sergeant Wild Card.

items.name: Cutlass
items.mechanics: Str+d8; −1 Parry if paired with pistol.

items.name: Naval Musket
items.description: Long arm for marines and hunters.

items.name: Fine Aged Rum
items.mechanics: Bribe or Persuade +1 once; hangover −1 Vigor next day.

items.name: Brass Compass
items.mechanics: Navigation +1; fails in ghost_shoals without witch ward.

items.name: Spyglass
items.mechanics: Notice +2 at range; identify flags at 1 mile.

items.name: Brass Diving Helmet
items.description: Pump-fed helm for shallow trench work.

items.name: Grappling Hook & Line

items.name: Black Pearl of the Trench
items.description: Jet pearl warm to the touch.
items.mechanics: Worth 500 gp; owner draws storms (GM discretion).

items.name: Sea-Witch Salt Charm
items.mechanics: Ignore one curse or ghost-shoals compulsion.

items.name: Smuggler's Shoal Chart
items.mechanics: Navigation +2 in central_archipelago; illegal in Crown ports.

factions.name: Crown Armada
factions.description: Colonial navy and marines enforcing tariffs, charters, and hangings.
factions.goals: Control every harbor; crush pirate republics; monopolize powder and ship timber.

factions.name: Free Corsair Council
factions.description: Loose confederation of pirate captains voting at Tortuga-style moots.
factions.goals: Keep ports free of Crown law; split spoils fairly; hang traitors from the yardarm.

factions.name: Coven of Tides
factions.description: Sea-witch sisterhood binding storms, curses, and tidal omens.
factions.goals: Protect Ghost Shoals; punish oath-breakers; recover Deluge relics from the trench.

lore.title: The Great Deluge
lore.content: Three centuries ago the sea rose in a single season, swallowing empires and leaving Caribdus a reef-strewn graveyard. Sailors say the trench still belches the bones of drowned cities.

lore.title: Treaty of Broken Anchors
lore.content: A fragile truce between Crown Armada and the Corsair Council: no firing in designated anchorages, exchange of prisoners, and shared charts through neutral Perla Azul. Both sides cheat.

lore.title: Curse of the Black Pearl
lore.content: A jet pearl taken from the trench is said to weigh down a captain's soul. Ships carrying one never outrun the same storm twice.

lore.title: Bells of the Ghost Shoals
lore.content: Drowned sailors ring wrecks at dusk. Hearing the bells thrice marks you for the sea hags unless a witch breaks the omen with salt and blood.

maps.description: Shallow wrecks, witch huts, and tide rips hatched in gray.

principles: Query the world pack for established locations, NPCs, and encounters before inventing.
Invent only when the pack has no matching content or the party goes off the authored map.
Use encounter tables for random wilderness and urban night scenes.
anti_patterns: Inventing a named shopkeeper when list_location_npcs returns candidates.
Rolling custom random encounters when a biome table exists.

avoid: Replacing Taberna del Ancla Podrida with a generic tavern
scenarios.invent_when: Players seek a shop type not listed — invent name but reuse market or dock tags.

avoid: Custom naval encounters when encounter_open_sea exists

compatibility.notes: Future engine wiring maps worldpack query tools to adventure module lookups.
